#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

EXPECTED_PREFIX="$HOME/.local"
AOE_LATEST_RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/njbrake/agent-of-empires/releases/latest"
BUN_LATEST_RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/oven-sh/bun/releases/latest"
# Packages whose engines are compared against the runtimes this workstation
# supplies. Bun is the updater's own; Node comes from the Home Manager profile.
MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS=(
  "Codex CLI (standalone)|@openai/codex"
  "Claude Code CLI|@anthropic-ai/claude-code"
  "Pi agent CLI|@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent"
  "OpenCode CLI|opencode-ai"
  "Oh My Pi CLI|@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent"
  "codex-acp adapter|@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp"
  "claude-agent-acp adapter|@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp"
  "pi-acp adapter|pi-acp"
)
STATE_HOME="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
STATE_DIR="$STATE_HOME/update-agent-tools"
STATE_FILE="$STATE_DIR/state.json"
LOCK_FILE="$STATE_DIR/lock"
readonly CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE=10

freshness_check_mode=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--freshness-check-if-due' && $# -eq 1 ]]; then
  freshness_check_mode=true
fi
record_freshness_failure_mode=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--record-freshness-failure' && $# -eq 1 ]]; then
  record_freshness_failure_mode=true
fi

fail() {
  printf 'update-agent-tools: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "flock missing from PATH"
exec 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
if [[ "$freshness_check_mode" == true \
  || "$record_freshness_failure_mode" == true ]]; then
  flock --nonblock 9 \
    || fail "freshness check unavailable: agent-tool maintenance is already running"
else
  flock 9
fi

now_epoch="$(date -u -d "${UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW:-now}" +%s)" \
  || fail "invalid current time"
now_iso="$(date -u -d "@$now_epoch" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

state_value() {
  local field="$1"

  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    jq -er ".$field // empty" "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

write_check_state() {
  local last_attempt="$1"
  local last_successful_check="$2"
  local cached_version_result="$3"
  local check_status="$4"
  local last_successful_activation
  local activation_failure
  local temporary_state

  last_successful_activation="$(state_value last_successful_activation)"
  activation_failure="null"
  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    activation_failure="$(jq -c '.activation_failure // null' "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || printf 'null')"
  fi
  temporary_state="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/state.json.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  chmod 600 "$temporary_state"
  jq -n \
    --arg last_attempt "$last_attempt" \
    --arg last_successful_check "$last_successful_check" \
    --arg cached_version_result "$cached_version_result" \
    --arg check_status "$check_status" \
    --arg last_successful_activation "$last_successful_activation" \
    --argjson activation_failure "$activation_failure" \
    '{
      last_attempt: $last_attempt,
      last_successful_check: (
        if $last_successful_check == "" then null else $last_successful_check end
      ),
      cached_version_result: $cached_version_result,
      check_status: $check_status,
      last_successful_activation: (
        if $last_successful_activation == "" then null
        else $last_successful_activation end
      ),
      activation_failure: $activation_failure
    }' >"$temporary_state"
  mv -f "$temporary_state" "$STATE_FILE"
}

if [[ "$record_freshness_failure_mode" == true ]]; then
  write_check_state \
    "$now_iso" \
    "$(state_value last_successful_check)" \
    "$(state_value cached_version_result)" \
    failed
  exit 0
fi

command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "npm missing from PATH"

actual_prefix="$(npm config get prefix)"
test "$actual_prefix" = "$EXPECTED_PREFIX" \
  || fail "npm prefix must be $EXPECTED_PREFIX, got $actual_prefix"

write_activation_state() {
  local successful_at="$1"
  local failure_phase="$2"
  local failure_component="$3"
  local current_state='{}'
  local temporary_state

  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    current_state="$(jq -c . "$STATE_FILE")" \
      || fail "state update failed: invalid state file"
  fi
  temporary_state="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/state.json.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  chmod 600 "$temporary_state"
  jq -n \
    --argjson current_state "$current_state" \
    --arg successful_at "$successful_at" \
    --arg failure_phase "$failure_phase" \
    --arg failure_component "$failure_component" \
    --arg failed_at "$now_iso" \
    '$current_state + {
      last_successful_activation: (
        if $successful_at == "" then $current_state.last_successful_activation
        else $successful_at end
      ),
      activation_failure: (
        if $failure_phase == "" then null
        else {
          phase: $failure_phase,
          component: $failure_component,
          failed_at: $failed_at
        } end
      )
    }' >"$temporary_state"
  mv -f "$temporary_state" "$STATE_FILE"
}

activation_fail() {
  local phase="$1"
  local component="$2"

  write_activation_state "" "$phase" "$component"
  fail "$phase failed: $component"
}

read_acp_workers() {
  local workers

  workers="$(aoe ps --acp --dead --json)" || return 1
  jq -ce '
    if type != "array" then error("expected an array") else . end
    | map(
        if (
          (.session_id | type) == "string"
          and (.session_id | length) > 0
          and (.pid | type) == "number"
          and (.alive | type) == "boolean"
          and (.build_stale | type) == "boolean"
        ) then {
          session_id,
          pid,
          alive,
          build_stale
        } else error("invalid ACP worker") end
      )
  ' <<<"$workers"
}

captured_workers_replaced_and_healthy() {
  local current_workers="$1"
  local captured_workers="$2"

  jq -e --argjson captured "$captured_workers" '
    . as $current
    | [
        $captured[] as $before
        | (
            any(
              $current[];
              .session_id == $before.session_id
              and .pid != $before.pid
              and .alive == true
              and .build_stale == false
            )
            and all(
              $current[];
              .session_id != $before.session_id
              or .pid != $before.pid
              or .alive != true
            )
          )
      ]
    | all
  ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null
}

wait_for_aoe_service() {
  local health_attempt=1

  while (( health_attempt <= 10 )); do
    if systemctl --user is-active --quiet aoe-serve.service; then
      return 0
    fi
    if (( health_attempt < 10 )); then
      sleep 1
    fi
    health_attempt=$((health_attempt + 1))
  done
  return 1
}

wait_for_aoe_health() {
  local health_attempt=1

  aoe_health_component="AoE service"
  while (( health_attempt <= 10 )); do
    if systemctl --user is-active --quiet aoe-serve.service; then
      aoe_health_component="AoE ACP diagnostics"
      if aoe acp doctor; then
        return 0
      fi
    else
      aoe_health_component="AoE service"
    fi
    if (( health_attempt < 10 )); then
      sleep 1
    fi
    health_attempt=$((health_attempt + 1))
  done
  return 1
}

bun_archive_name() {
  # Bun's own npm installer never selects a baseline build, so a pre-AVX2 host
  # would get an AVX2 binary that dies on its first instruction. Choosing the
  # archive here is what lets the updater own Bun at all.
  if grep -qw avx2 "${UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_CPUINFO:-/proc/cpuinfo}" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'bun-linux-x64.zip\n'
  else
    printf 'bun-linux-x64-baseline.zip\n'
  fi
}

resolve_bun_release() {
  local archive
  local release

  archive="$(bun_archive_name)"
  release="$(curl -fsSL "$BUN_LATEST_RELEASE_URL")" || return 1
  jq -er --arg archive "$archive" '
    (.tag_name // "" | sub("^bun-v"; "")) as $version
    | (.assets // [] | map(select(.name == $archive)) | first) as $asset
    | if ($version | test("^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$"))
        and $asset != null
        and (($asset.browser_download_url // "") | length) > 0
        and (($asset.digest // "") | test("^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))
      then {
        version: $version,
        url: $asset.browser_download_url,
        digest: ($asset.digest | sub("^sha256:"; ""))
      }
      else error("unusable bun release") end
  ' <<<"$release"
}

bun_installed_version() {
  local version

  [[ "$(command -v bun || true)" == "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" ]] \
    || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  version="$(bun --version 2>/dev/null)" || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  [[ -n "$version" ]] || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$version"
}

bun_install_failed() {
  # Cleanup belongs to install_bun_runtime's EXIT trap, which also covers the
  # signals no explicit failure path can reach.
  fail "installation failed: Bun runtime ($1)"
}

install_bun_runtime() {
  local release="$1"
  local version
  local url
  local digest
  local work_dir
  local archive
  local extracted
  local observed
  local tool

  version="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$release")" \
    || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  url="$(jq -er '.url' <<<"$release")" || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  digest="$(jq -er '.digest' <<<"$release")" || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"

  # The profile supplies these, but the updater is runnable outside it, and the
  # repo's shape for a missing prerequisite is a named tool rather than a
  # downstream failure that blames the archive.
  for tool in curl unzip find sha256sum install; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$tool missing from PATH"
  done

  # A run killed mid-download leaves ~100MB of archive and extracted tree behind,
  # and nothing else ever visits these paths, so sweep before adding another.
  rm -rf "${STATE_DIR:?}"/bun.*
  work_dir="$(mktemp -d "$STATE_DIR/bun.XXXXXX")" \
    || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  # Covers the signals the explicit failure paths cannot: the trap is cleared on
  # the way out so a later exit does not delete an unrelated path.
  trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new"' EXIT
  archive="$work_dir/bun.zip"

  curl -fsSL -o "$archive" "$url" || bun_install_failed "download of $url"
  observed="$(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" \
    || bun_install_failed "checksum"
  [[ "$observed" == "$digest" ]] \
    || bun_install_failed "archive digest mismatch"
  unzip -q -o -d "$work_dir" "$archive" || bun_install_failed "archive"
  extracted="$(find "$work_dir" -mindepth 2 -type f -name bun -print -quit)"
  [[ -n "$extracted" ]] || bun_install_failed "archive layout"
  # Staged then renamed: replacing the path rather than writing through it keeps
  # a bun that is mid-run on its original inode.
  install -D -m 755 "$extracted" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new" \
    || bun_install_failed "staging"
  mv -f "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" \
    || bun_install_failed "replacement"
  ln -sfn bun "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bunx" || bun_install_failed "bunx"
  # Proves the archive actually held the Bun the release advertised, and that it
  # runs on this host at all, while the failure is still about Bun alone.
  observed="$("$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null)" \
    || bun_install_failed "installed Bun does not run"
  [[ "$observed" == "$version" ]] \
    || bun_install_failed "installed Bun reports $observed, expected $version"
  rm -rf "$work_dir"
  trap - EXIT
}

install_npm_component() {
  local component="$1"
  local package="$2"

  if ! npm install --global "$package"; then
    fail "installation failed: $component ($package)"
  fi
}

check_component() {
  local name="$1"
  local current="$2"
  local latest="$3"

  if [[ "$current" != "$latest" ]]; then
    printf '%s: %s -> %s\n' "$name" "$current" "$latest"
  fi
}

is_stable_version() {
  [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]
}

check_failure_component() {
  printf 'update-agent-tools-check-component: %s\n' "$1" >&2
  return 1
}

require_stable_version() {
  local component="$1"
  local version="$2"

  is_stable_version "$version" || check_failure_component "$component"
}

normalize_version() {
  local -a parts

  IFS=. read -r -a parts <<<"$1"
  printf '%s.%s.%s\n' "${parts[0]:-0}" "${parts[1]:-0}" "${parts[2]:-0}"
}

engine_floor() {
  # Only `>=X[.Y[.Z]]` is understood. An unrecognized range yields no floor, so a
  # range syntax this updater has never seen cannot wedge the whole toolchain.
  local range="$1"

  [[ "$range" =~ ^\>=[[:space:]]*([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2})$ ]] || return 0
  normalize_version "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
}

version_satisfies_floor() {
  local version
  local floor="$2"

  version="$(normalize_version "$1")"
  [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$version" "$floor" | sort -V | head -n 1)" == "$floor" ]]
}

node_installed_version() {
  local version

  version="$(node --version 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  version="${version#v}"
  [[ -n "$version" ]] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$version"
}

# Compares each harness's declared engines against the runtimes this update will
# leave behind: the Bun about to be installed, and the Node the Home Manager
# profile already supplies. Reports through runtime_engine_failure rather than
# printing, because discovery and the install phase phrase their refusals
# differently.
runtime_engine_failure=""
managed_npm_metadata_failure=""
declare -A managed_npm_latest_versions=()
declare -A managed_npm_engines=()

load_managed_npm_metadata() {
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local metadata
  local version
  local engines

  managed_npm_metadata_failure=""
  managed_npm_latest_versions=()
  managed_npm_engines=()
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    metadata="$(npm view "$package@latest" version engines --json 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    version="$(jq -er '.version | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' \
      <<<"$metadata" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    engines="$(jq -c '.engines // empty' <<<"$metadata" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    managed_npm_latest_versions["$package"]="$version"
    managed_npm_engines["$package"]="$engines"
  done
}

check_runtime_engines() {
  local bun_target="$1"
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local engines
  local runtime
  local range
  local floor
  local version
  local remedy
  local runtime_component

  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    # Unverifiable is not the same as satisfied. npm install does not enforce
    # engines — engine-strict defaults to false, so a floor violation is only a
    # warning there — which means skipping a package whose metadata failed to
    # load installs a harness that may not start, and the run then dies at the
    # post-install `$harness --version` with the harnesses already replaced.
    # That is the incident this guard exists to prevent, so the metadata loader
    # refuses before this check. A rerun costs a minute; the alternative costs
    # the toolchain.
    engines="${managed_npm_engines[$package]}"
    # An absent or malformed declaration is different: it is the package's
    # steady state, not a transient failure, so refusing would block updates
    # until an upstream author fixed it. Nothing to check means nothing to fail.
    [[ -n "$engines" ]] || continue
    jq -e 'type == "object"' <<<"$engines" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
    for runtime in bun node; do
      range="$(jq -r --arg runtime "$runtime" '.[$runtime] // empty' <<<"$engines")" \
        || continue
      [[ -n "$range" ]] || continue
      floor="$(engine_floor "$range")"
      [[ -n "$floor" ]] || continue
      if [[ "$runtime" == "bun" ]]; then
        runtime_component="Bun runtime"
        version="$bun_target"
        remedy="no Bun release satisfies it yet"
      else
        runtime_component="Node runtime"
        version="$(node_installed_version)" \
          || { runtime_engine_failure="$runtime_component"; return 1; }
        remedy="update the nixpkgs flake input to raise the profile's Node"
      fi
      version_satisfies_floor "$version" "$floor" && continue
      # The component string is the only failure detail that reaches the
      # operator, so the whole diagnosis travels in it.
      runtime_engine_failure="$runtime_component ($component needs $runtime $range, found $version; $remedy)"
      return 1
    done
  done

  return 0
}

check_toolchain() {
  local installed
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local latest
  local aoe_current="missing"
  local aoe_latest
  local bun_release
  local bun_latest
  local bundled_codex_range
  local bundled_codex_versions
  local bundled_codex_latest

  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }

  bun_release="$(resolve_bun_release)" \
    || { check_failure_component "Bun runtime"; return 1; }
  bun_latest="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$bun_release")" \
    || { check_failure_component "Bun runtime"; return 1; }
  require_stable_version "Bun runtime" "$bun_latest" || return 1

  if command -v aoe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    aoe_current="$(aoe --version)" \
      || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
    aoe_current="${aoe_current##* }"
  fi
  aoe_latest="$(curl -fsSL "$AOE_LATEST_RELEASE_URL" | jq -r '.tag_name')" \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  [[ -n "$aoe_latest" && "$aoe_latest" != "null" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  aoe_latest="${aoe_latest#v}"
  require_stable_version "AoE" "$aoe_latest" || return 1

  installed="$(npm list --global --json --all 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$installed" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }
  jq -e 'type == "object"' <<<"$installed" >/dev/null \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }

  load_managed_npm_metadata \
    || { check_failure_component "$managed_npm_metadata_failure"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_range="$(npm view \
    @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@latest \
    'dependencies.@openai/codex')" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  [[ "$bundled_codex_range" =~ [^[:space:]] ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  [[ "$bundled_codex_range" != "null" && "$bundled_codex_range" != "undefined" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_versions="$(npm view \
    "@openai/codex@$bundled_codex_range" \
    version \
    --json)" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_latest="$(jq -er '
    if type == "array" then . else [.] end
    | map(select(
        type == "string"
        and length > 0
        and (contains("-") | not)
      ))
    | last
  ' <<<"$bundled_codex_versions")" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  require_stable_version "Codex runtime (codex-acp)" "$bundled_codex_latest" \
    || return 1
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    require_stable_version \
      "$component" \
      "${managed_npm_latest_versions[$package]}" \
      || return 1
  done

  check_runtime_engines "$bun_latest" \
    || { check_failure_component "$runtime_engine_failure"; return 1; }

  check_component "Bun runtime" \
    "$(bun_installed_version)" \
    "$bun_latest"
  check_component "AoE" \
    "$aoe_current" \
    "$aoe_latest"
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    latest="${managed_npm_latest_versions[$package]}"
    check_component \
      "$component" \
      "$(jq -r --arg package "$package" \
        '.dependencies[$package].version // "missing"' <<<"$installed")" \
      "$latest"
  done
  check_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)" \
    "$(jq -r '.dependencies["@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp"].dependencies["@openai/codex"].version // "missing"' <<<"$installed")" \
    "$bundled_codex_latest"
}

print_cached_result() {
  local cached_result="$1"

  if [[ -n "$cached_result" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$cached_result"
    if [[ "$freshness_check_mode" != true ]]; then
      printf 'Run: update-agent-tools\n'
    fi
  fi
}

print_check_failure() {
  local last_successful_check="$1"
  local retry_iso="$2"

  printf 'update-agent-tools: agent-tool update check failed; last successful check: %s; next retry: %s\n' \
    "${last_successful_check:-never}" \
    "$retry_iso" >&2
}

fresh_check_result=""
fresh_check_failure_component=""
run_fresh_check() {
  local output_file
  local error_file
  local last_successful_check
  local cached_result

  output_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/check.stdout.XXXXXX")"
  error_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/check.stderr.XXXXXX")"
  if (check_toolchain) >"$output_file" 2>"$error_file"; then
    fresh_check_result="$(<"$output_file")"
    rm -f "$output_file" "$error_file"
    write_check_state \
      "$now_iso" \
      "$now_iso" \
      "$fresh_check_result" \
      "success"
    return 0
  fi

  fresh_check_failure_component="$(sed -n \
    's/^update-agent-tools-check-component: //p' \
    "$error_file" | tail -n 1)"
  rm -f "$output_file" "$error_file"
  last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  cached_result="$(state_value cached_version_result)"
  write_check_state \
    "$now_iso" \
    "$last_successful_check" \
    "$cached_result" \
    "failed"
  return 1
}

run_check() {
  local last_successful_check
  local retry_iso

  if run_fresh_check; then
    print_cached_result "$fresh_check_result"
    return 0
  fi

  last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  retry_iso="$(date -u -d "@$((now_epoch + 3600))" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  print_check_failure "$last_successful_check" "$retry_iso"
  return 1
}

run_status_check() {
  run_fresh_check || return 1
  if [[ -n "$fresh_check_result" \
    || -n "$(state_value activation_failure)" ]]; then
    return "$CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
  fi
  return 0
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check-status" ]]; then
  [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || fail "--check-status does not accept arguments"
  if run_status_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit $?
  fi
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then
  [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || fail "--check does not accept arguments"
  if run_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check-if-due" \
  || "${1:-}" == "--freshness-check-if-due" ]]; then
  local_last_attempt="$(state_value last_attempt)"
  local_last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  local_cached_result="$(state_value cached_version_result)"
  local_check_status="$(state_value check_status)"

  if [[ -n "$local_last_attempt" ]]; then
    if [[ "$local_check_status" == "failed" ]]; then
      next_check_epoch="$(date -u -d "$local_last_attempt + 1 hour" +%s)"
    else
      next_check_epoch="$(date -u -d "$local_last_successful_check + 24 hours" +%s)"
    fi

    if (( now_epoch < next_check_epoch )); then
      if [[ "$local_check_status" == "failed" ]]; then
        next_check_iso="$(date -u -d "@$next_check_epoch" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
        print_check_failure "$local_last_successful_check" "$next_check_iso"
      else
        print_cached_result "$local_cached_result"
      fi
      exit 0
    fi
  fi

  if run_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit 1
  fi
fi

assume_yes=false
update_if_needed=false
if [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "--yes" ]]; then
  assume_yes=true
elif [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "--update-if-needed" ]]; then
  update_if_needed=true
elif [[ $# -eq 2 && "$1" == "--update-if-needed" && "$2" == "--yes" ]]; then
  update_if_needed=true
  assume_yes=true
elif [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
  fail "unknown argument: $1"
fi

if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
  if run_status_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    status=$?
    if [[ "$status" -ne "$CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE" ]]; then
      fail "discovery phase failed: ${fresh_check_failure_component:-agent-tool version discovery}; correct the problem, then rerun workstation-update"
    fi
  fi
fi

command -v aoe >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || fail "installation failed: AoE command missing from PATH"
captured_workers="$(read_acp_workers)" \
  || fail "unable to inspect running ACP sessions"
captured_workers="$(jq -c '
  [
    .[]
    | select(.alive == true)
    | {session_id, pid}
  ]
  | unique_by([.session_id, .pid])
' <<<"$captured_workers")" \
  || fail "unable to inspect running ACP sessions"
captured_worker_count="$(jq -r 'length' <<<"$captured_workers")"
if [[ "$captured_worker_count" -eq 1 ]]; then
  captured_worker_noun="session"
else
  captured_worker_noun="sessions"
fi
if (( captured_worker_count > 0 )) && [[ "$assume_yes" == false ]]; then
  if [[ ! -t 0 ]]; then
    if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
      fail "$captured_worker_count running ACP $captured_worker_noun would be disrupted; rerun workstation-update --yes to authorize replacement"
    fi
    fail "$captured_worker_count running ACP $captured_worker_noun would be disrupted; rerun with --yes to authorize replacement"
  fi
  printf 'update-agent-tools: %s running ACP %s would be disrupted. Continue? [y/N] ' \
    "$captured_worker_count" "$captured_worker_noun" >&2
  if ! IFS= read -r disruption_confirmation \
    || [[ ! "$disruption_confirmation" =~ ^[Yy]([Ee][Ss])?$ ]]; then
    fail "update cancelled"
  fi
fi

if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
  write_activation_state "" "maintenance" "agent-tool update"
fi

# Bun first: it is the runtime the npm harnesses execute under, so installing it
# ahead of them is what keeps a harness from landing on a Bun too old to run it.
#
# The guard runs here rather than only in discovery because --yes and the bare
# invocation never reach check_toolchain before mutating: the Home Manager
# bootstrap handoff uses --yes, so a floor checked only at discovery would leave
# exactly that path replacing the harnesses first and refusing afterwards.
bun_release="$(resolve_bun_release)" \
  || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime (release metadata)"
bun_target="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$bun_release")" \
  || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime (release metadata)"
load_managed_npm_metadata \
  || fail "update refused before any change: $managed_npm_metadata_failure (engine metadata unavailable)"
check_runtime_engines "$bun_target" \
  || fail "update refused before any change: $runtime_engine_failure"

if [[ "$(bun_installed_version)" == "$bun_target" ]]; then
  printf 'Bun runtime %s is current\n' "$bun_target"
else
  install_bun_runtime "$bun_release"
fi

if ! aoe update --yes; then
  fail "installation failed: AoE"
fi

for binary in codex claude pi opencode omp; do
  binary_path="$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/$binary"
  if [[ -e "$binary_path" || -L "$binary_path" ]]; then
    rm -f "$binary_path"
  fi
done

for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
  component="${entry%%|*}"
  package="${entry#*|}"
  install_npm_component "$component" "$package@latest"
done

hash -r 2>/dev/null || true

for binary in \
  aoe bun codex claude pi opencode omp codex-acp claude-agent-acp pi-acp; do
  expected_path="$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/$binary"
  actual_path="$(command -v "$binary" || true)"
  test "$actual_path" = "$expected_path" \
    || fail "pre-activation verification failed: $binary command must resolve to $expected_path, got ${actual_path:-missing}"
done

for harness in opencode omp pi; do
  "$harness" --version >/dev/null \
    || fail "pre-activation verification failed: $harness --version"
done

verification_output_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/verification.stdout.XXXXXX")"
verification_error_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/verification.stderr.XXXXXX")"
if ! check_toolchain >"$verification_output_file" 2>"$verification_error_file"; then
  verification_component="$(sed -n \
    's/^update-agent-tools-check-component: //p' \
    "$verification_error_file" | tail -n 1)"
  rm -f "$verification_output_file" "$verification_error_file"
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: ${verification_component:-toolchain verification}"
fi
verification_output="$(<"$verification_output_file")"
rm -f "$verification_output_file" "$verification_error_file"
if [[ -n "$verification_output" ]]; then
  failed_component="${verification_output%%:*}"
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: $failed_component version"
fi

if ! aoe acp doctor; then
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: AoE ACP diagnostics"
fi

if ! systemctl --user restart aoe-serve.service; then
  activation_fail "activation" "AoE service restart"
fi

if (( captured_worker_count > 0 )); then
  wait_for_aoe_service \
    || activation_fail "post-activation verification" "AoE service"

  mapfile -t captured_worker_sessions < <(jq -r '
    unique_by(.session_id)
    | .[].session_id
  ' <<<"$captured_workers")
  for worker_session_id in "${captured_worker_sessions[@]}"; do
    current_workers="$(read_acp_workers)" \
      || activation_fail \
        "post-activation verification" \
        "ACP session replacement"
    if jq -e \
      --arg session_id "$worker_session_id" \
      --argjson captured "$captured_workers" '
        ($captured
          | map(select(.session_id == $session_id))
          | first
        ) as $before
        | any(
            .[];
            .session_id == $session_id
            and .pid != $before.pid
          )
      ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    if ! jq -e \
      --arg session_id "$worker_session_id" '
        any(.[]; .session_id == $session_id)
      ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    if ! aoe acp restart "$worker_session_id"; then
      activation_fail "activation" "ACP worker restart"
    fi
  done

  workers_healthy=false
  worker_health_attempt=1
  while (( worker_health_attempt <= 10 )); do
    current_workers="$(read_acp_workers)" \
      || activation_fail \
        "post-activation verification" \
        "ACP session replacement"
    if captured_workers_replaced_and_healthy \
      "$current_workers" "$captured_workers"; then
      workers_healthy=true
      break
    fi
    if (( worker_health_attempt < 10 )); then
      sleep 1
    fi
item.formatted_output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

EXPECTED_PREFIX="$HOME/.local"
AOE_LATEST_RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/njbrake/agent-of-empires/releases/latest"
BUN_LATEST_RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/oven-sh/bun/releases/latest"
# Packages whose engines are compared against the runtimes this workstation
# supplies. Bun is the updater's own; Node comes from the Home Manager profile.
MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS=(
  "Codex CLI (standalone)|@openai/codex"
  "Claude Code CLI|@anthropic-ai/claude-code"
  "Pi agent CLI|@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent"
  "OpenCode CLI|opencode-ai"
  "Oh My Pi CLI|@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent"
  "codex-acp adapter|@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp"
  "claude-agent-acp adapter|@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp"
  "pi-acp adapter|pi-acp"
)
STATE_HOME="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
STATE_DIR="$STATE_HOME/update-agent-tools"
STATE_FILE="$STATE_DIR/state.json"
LOCK_FILE="$STATE_DIR/lock"
readonly CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE=10

freshness_check_mode=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--freshness-check-if-due' && $# -eq 1 ]]; then
  freshness_check_mode=true
fi
record_freshness_failure_mode=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--record-freshness-failure' && $# -eq 1 ]]; then
  record_freshness_failure_mode=true
fi

fail() {
  printf 'update-agent-tools: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "flock missing from PATH"
exec 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
if [[ "$freshness_check_mode" == true \
  || "$record_freshness_failure_mode" == true ]]; then
  flock --nonblock 9 \
    || fail "freshness check unavailable: agent-tool maintenance is already running"
else
  flock 9
fi

now_epoch="$(date -u -d "${UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW:-now}" +%s)" \
  || fail "invalid current time"
now_iso="$(date -u -d "@$now_epoch" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

state_value() {
  local field="$1"

  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    jq -er ".$field // empty" "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

write_check_state() {
  local last_attempt="$1"
  local last_successful_check="$2"
  local cached_version_result="$3"
  local check_status="$4"
  local last_successful_activation
  local activation_failure
  local temporary_state

  last_successful_activation="$(state_value last_successful_activation)"
  activation_failure="null"
  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    activation_failure="$(jq -c '.activation_failure // null' "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || printf 'null')"
  fi
  temporary_state="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/state.json.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  chmod 600 "$temporary_state"
  jq -n \
    --arg last_attempt "$last_attempt" \
    --arg last_successful_check "$last_successful_check" \
    --arg cached_version_result "$cached_version_result" \
    --arg check_status "$check_status" \
    --arg last_successful_activation "$last_successful_activation" \
    --argjson activation_failure "$activation_failure" \
    '{
      last_attempt: $last_attempt,
      last_successful_check: (
        if $last_successful_check == "" then null else $last_successful_check end
      ),
      cached_version_result: $cached_version_result,
      check_status: $check_status,
      last_successful_activation: (
        if $last_successful_activation == "" then null
        else $last_successful_activation end
      ),
      activation_failure: $activation_failure
    }' >"$temporary_state"
  mv -f "$temporary_state" "$STATE_FILE"
}

if [[ "$record_freshness_failure_mode" == true ]]; then
  write_check_state \
    "$now_iso" \
    "$(state_value last_successful_check)" \
    "$(state_value cached_version_result)" \
    failed
  exit 0
fi

command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "npm missing from PATH"

actual_prefix="$(npm config get prefix)"
test "$actual_prefix" = "$EXPECTED_PREFIX" \
  || fail "npm prefix must be $EXPECTED_PREFIX, got $actual_prefix"

write_activation_state() {
  local successful_at="$1"
  local failure_phase="$2"
  local failure_component="$3"
  local current_state='{}'
  local temporary_state

  if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
    current_state="$(jq -c . "$STATE_FILE")" \
      || fail "state update failed: invalid state file"
  fi
  temporary_state="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/state.json.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  chmod 600 "$temporary_state"
  jq -n \
    --argjson current_state "$current_state" \
    --arg successful_at "$successful_at" \
    --arg failure_phase "$failure_phase" \
    --arg failure_component "$failure_component" \
    --arg failed_at "$now_iso" \
    '$current_state + {
      last_successful_activation: (
        if $successful_at == "" then $current_state.last_successful_activation
        else $successful_at end
      ),
      activation_failure: (
        if $failure_phase == "" then null
        else {
          phase: $failure_phase,
          component: $failure_component,
          failed_at: $failed_at
        } end
      )
    }' >"$temporary_state"
  mv -f "$temporary_state" "$STATE_FILE"
}

activation_fail() {
  local phase="$1"
  local component="$2"

  write_activation_state "" "$phase" "$component"
  fail "$phase failed: $component"
}

read_acp_workers() {
  local workers

  workers="$(aoe ps --acp --dead --json)" || return 1
  jq -ce '
    if type != "array" then error("expected an array") else . end
    | map(
        if (
          (.session_id | type) == "string"
          and (.session_id | length) > 0
          and (.pid | type) == "number"
          and (.alive | type) == "boolean"
          and (.build_stale | type) == "boolean"
        ) then {
          session_id,
          pid,
          alive,
          build_stale
        } else error("invalid ACP worker") end
      )
  ' <<<"$workers"
}

captured_workers_replaced_and_healthy() {
  local current_workers="$1"
  local captured_workers="$2"

  jq -e --argjson captured "$captured_workers" '
    . as $current
    | [
        $captured[] as $before
        | (
            any(
              $current[];
              .session_id == $before.session_id
              and .pid != $before.pid
              and .alive == true
              and .build_stale == false
            )
            and all(
              $current[];
              .session_id != $before.session_id
              or .pid != $before.pid
              or .alive != true
            )
          )
      ]
    | all
  ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null
}

wait_for_aoe_service() {
  local health_attempt=1

  while (( health_attempt <= 10 )); do
    if systemctl --user is-active --quiet aoe-serve.service; then
      return 0
    fi
    if (( health_attempt < 10 )); then
      sleep 1
    fi
    health_attempt=$((health_attempt + 1))
  done
  return 1
}

wait_for_aoe_health() {
  local health_attempt=1

  aoe_health_component="AoE service"
  while (( health_attempt <= 10 )); do
    if systemctl --user is-active --quiet aoe-serve.service; then
      aoe_health_component="AoE ACP diagnostics"
      if aoe acp doctor; then
        return 0
      fi
    else
      aoe_health_component="AoE service"
    fi
    if (( health_attempt < 10 )); then
      sleep 1
    fi
    health_attempt=$((health_attempt + 1))
  done
  return 1
}

bun_archive_name() {
  # Bun's own npm installer never selects a baseline build, so a pre-AVX2 host
  # would get an AVX2 binary that dies on its first instruction. Choosing the
  # archive here is what lets the updater own Bun at all.
  if grep -qw avx2 "${UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_CPUINFO:-/proc/cpuinfo}" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'bun-linux-x64.zip\n'
  else
    printf 'bun-linux-x64-baseline.zip\n'
  fi
}

resolve_bun_release() {
  local archive
  local release

  archive="$(bun_archive_name)"
  release="$(curl -fsSL "$BUN_LATEST_RELEASE_URL")" || return 1
  jq -er --arg archive "$archive" '
    (.tag_name // "" | sub("^bun-v"; "")) as $version
    | (.assets // [] | map(select(.name == $archive)) | first) as $asset
    | if ($version | test("^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$"))
        and $asset != null
        and (($asset.browser_download_url // "") | length) > 0
        and (($asset.digest // "") | test("^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))
      then {
        version: $version,
        url: $asset.browser_download_url,
        digest: ($asset.digest | sub("^sha256:"; ""))
      }
      else error("unusable bun release") end
  ' <<<"$release"
}

bun_installed_version() {
  local version

  [[ "$(command -v bun || true)" == "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" ]] \
    || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  version="$(bun --version 2>/dev/null)" || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  [[ -n "$version" ]] || { printf 'missing\n'; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$version"
}

bun_install_failed() {
  # Cleanup belongs to install_bun_runtime's EXIT trap, which also covers the
  # signals no explicit failure path can reach.
  fail "installation failed: Bun runtime ($1)"
}

install_bun_runtime() {
  local release="$1"
  local version
  local url
  local digest
  local work_dir
  local archive
  local extracted
  local observed
  local tool

  version="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$release")" \
    || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  url="$(jq -er '.url' <<<"$release")" || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  digest="$(jq -er '.digest' <<<"$release")" || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"

  # The profile supplies these, but the updater is runnable outside it, and the
  # repo's shape for a missing prerequisite is a named tool rather than a
  # downstream failure that blames the archive.
  for tool in curl unzip find sha256sum install; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$tool missing from PATH"
  done

  # A run killed mid-download leaves ~100MB of archive and extracted tree behind,
  # and nothing else ever visits these paths, so sweep before adding another.
  rm -rf "${STATE_DIR:?}"/bun.*
  work_dir="$(mktemp -d "$STATE_DIR/bun.XXXXXX")" \
    || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime"
  # Covers the signals the explicit failure paths cannot: the trap is cleared on
  # the way out so a later exit does not delete an unrelated path.
  trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new"' EXIT
  archive="$work_dir/bun.zip"

  curl -fsSL -o "$archive" "$url" || bun_install_failed "download of $url"
  observed="$(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" \
    || bun_install_failed "checksum"
  [[ "$observed" == "$digest" ]] \
    || bun_install_failed "archive digest mismatch"
  unzip -q -o -d "$work_dir" "$archive" || bun_install_failed "archive"
  extracted="$(find "$work_dir" -mindepth 2 -type f -name bun -print -quit)"
  [[ -n "$extracted" ]] || bun_install_failed "archive layout"
  # Staged then renamed: replacing the path rather than writing through it keeps
  # a bun that is mid-run on its original inode.
  install -D -m 755 "$extracted" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new" \
    || bun_install_failed "staging"
  mv -f "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/.bun.new" "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" \
    || bun_install_failed "replacement"
  ln -sfn bun "$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bunx" || bun_install_failed "bunx"
  # Proves the archive actually held the Bun the release advertised, and that it
  # runs on this host at all, while the failure is still about Bun alone.
  observed="$("$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null)" \
    || bun_install_failed "installed Bun does not run"
  [[ "$observed" == "$version" ]] \
    || bun_install_failed "installed Bun reports $observed, expected $version"
  rm -rf "$work_dir"
  trap - EXIT
}

install_npm_component() {
  local component="$1"
  local package="$2"

  if ! npm install --global "$package"; then
    fail "installation failed: $component ($package)"
  fi
}

check_component() {
  local name="$1"
  local current="$2"
  local latest="$3"

  if [[ "$current" != "$latest" ]]; then
    printf '%s: %s -> %s\n' "$name" "$current" "$latest"
  fi
}

is_stable_version() {
  [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]
}

check_failure_component() {
  printf 'update-agent-tools-check-component: %s\n' "$1" >&2
  return 1
}

require_stable_version() {
  local component="$1"
  local version="$2"

  is_stable_version "$version" || check_failure_component "$component"
}

normalize_version() {
  local -a parts

  IFS=. read -r -a parts <<<"$1"
  printf '%s.%s.%s\n' "${parts[0]:-0}" "${parts[1]:-0}" "${parts[2]:-0}"
}

engine_floor() {
  # Only `>=X[.Y[.Z]]` is understood. An unrecognized range yields no floor, so a
  # range syntax this updater has never seen cannot wedge the whole toolchain.
  local range="$1"

  [[ "$range" =~ ^\>=[[:space:]]*([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2})$ ]] || return 0
  normalize_version "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
}

version_satisfies_floor() {
  local version
  local floor="$2"

  version="$(normalize_version "$1")"
  [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$version" "$floor" | sort -V | head -n 1)" == "$floor" ]]
}

node_installed_version() {
  local version

  version="$(node --version 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  version="${version#v}"
  [[ -n "$version" ]] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$version"
}

# Compares each harness's declared engines against the runtimes this update will
# leave behind: the Bun about to be installed, and the Node the Home Manager
# profile already supplies. Reports through runtime_engine_failure rather than
# printing, because discovery and the install phase phrase their refusals
# differently.
runtime_engine_failure=""
managed_npm_metadata_failure=""
declare -A managed_npm_latest_versions=()
declare -A managed_npm_engines=()

load_managed_npm_metadata() {
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local metadata
  local version
  local engines

  managed_npm_metadata_failure=""
  managed_npm_latest_versions=()
  managed_npm_engines=()
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    metadata="$(npm view "$package@latest" version engines --json 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    version="$(jq -er '.version | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' \
      <<<"$metadata" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    engines="$(jq -c '.engines // empty' <<<"$metadata" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { managed_npm_metadata_failure="$component"; return 1; }
    managed_npm_latest_versions["$package"]="$version"
    managed_npm_engines["$package"]="$engines"
  done
}

check_runtime_engines() {
  local bun_target="$1"
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local engines
  local runtime
  local range
  local floor
  local version
  local remedy
  local runtime_component

  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    # Unverifiable is not the same as satisfied. npm install does not enforce
    # engines — engine-strict defaults to false, so a floor violation is only a
    # warning there — which means skipping a package whose metadata failed to
    # load installs a harness that may not start, and the run then dies at the
    # post-install `$harness --version` with the harnesses already replaced.
    # That is the incident this guard exists to prevent, so the metadata loader
    # refuses before this check. A rerun costs a minute; the alternative costs
    # the toolchain.
    engines="${managed_npm_engines[$package]}"
    # An absent or malformed declaration is different: it is the package's
    # steady state, not a transient failure, so refusing would block updates
    # until an upstream author fixed it. Nothing to check means nothing to fail.
    [[ -n "$engines" ]] || continue
    jq -e 'type == "object"' <<<"$engines" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
    for runtime in bun node; do
      range="$(jq -r --arg runtime "$runtime" '.[$runtime] // empty' <<<"$engines")" \
        || continue
      [[ -n "$range" ]] || continue
      floor="$(engine_floor "$range")"
      [[ -n "$floor" ]] || continue
      if [[ "$runtime" == "bun" ]]; then
        runtime_component="Bun runtime"
        version="$bun_target"
        remedy="no Bun release satisfies it yet"
      else
        runtime_component="Node runtime"
        version="$(node_installed_version)" \
          || { runtime_engine_failure="$runtime_component"; return 1; }
        remedy="update the nixpkgs flake input to raise the profile's Node"
      fi
      version_satisfies_floor "$version" "$floor" && continue
      # The component string is the only failure detail that reaches the
      # operator, so the whole diagnosis travels in it.
      runtime_engine_failure="$runtime_component ($component needs $runtime $range, found $version; $remedy)"
      return 1
    done
  done

  return 0
}

check_toolchain() {
  local installed
  local entry
  local component
  local package
  local latest
  local aoe_current="missing"
  local aoe_latest
  local bun_release
  local bun_latest
  local bundled_codex_range
  local bundled_codex_versions
  local bundled_codex_latest

  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }

  bun_release="$(resolve_bun_release)" \
    || { check_failure_component "Bun runtime"; return 1; }
  bun_latest="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$bun_release")" \
    || { check_failure_component "Bun runtime"; return 1; }
  require_stable_version "Bun runtime" "$bun_latest" || return 1

  if command -v aoe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    aoe_current="$(aoe --version)" \
      || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
    aoe_current="${aoe_current##* }"
  fi
  aoe_latest="$(curl -fsSL "$AOE_LATEST_RELEASE_URL" | jq -r '.tag_name')" \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  [[ -n "$aoe_latest" && "$aoe_latest" != "null" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "AoE"; return 1; }
  aoe_latest="${aoe_latest#v}"
  require_stable_version "AoE" "$aoe_latest" || return 1

  installed="$(npm list --global --json --all 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$installed" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }
  jq -e 'type == "object"' <<<"$installed" >/dev/null \
    || { check_failure_component "npm package inventory"; return 1; }

  load_managed_npm_metadata \
    || { check_failure_component "$managed_npm_metadata_failure"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_range="$(npm view \
    @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@latest \
    'dependencies.@openai/codex')" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  [[ "$bundled_codex_range" =~ [^[:space:]] ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  [[ "$bundled_codex_range" != "null" && "$bundled_codex_range" != "undefined" ]] \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_versions="$(npm view \
    "@openai/codex@$bundled_codex_range" \
    version \
    --json)" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  bundled_codex_latest="$(jq -er '
    if type == "array" then . else [.] end
    | map(select(
        type == "string"
        and length > 0
        and (contains("-") | not)
      ))
    | last
  ' <<<"$bundled_codex_versions")" \
    || { check_failure_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)"; return 1; }
  require_stable_version "Codex runtime (codex-acp)" "$bundled_codex_latest" \
    || return 1
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    require_stable_version \
      "$component" \
      "${managed_npm_latest_versions[$package]}" \
      || return 1
  done

  check_runtime_engines "$bun_latest" \
    || { check_failure_component "$runtime_engine_failure"; return 1; }

  check_component "Bun runtime" \
    "$(bun_installed_version)" \
    "$bun_latest"
  check_component "AoE" \
    "$aoe_current" \
    "$aoe_latest"
  for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
    component="${entry%%|*}"
    package="${entry#*|}"
    latest="${managed_npm_latest_versions[$package]}"
    check_component \
      "$component" \
      "$(jq -r --arg package "$package" \
        '.dependencies[$package].version // "missing"' <<<"$installed")" \
      "$latest"
  done
  check_component "Codex runtime (codex-acp)" \
    "$(jq -r '.dependencies["@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp"].dependencies["@openai/codex"].version // "missing"' <<<"$installed")" \
    "$bundled_codex_latest"
}

print_cached_result() {
  local cached_result="$1"

  if [[ -n "$cached_result" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$cached_result"
    if [[ "$freshness_check_mode" != true ]]; then
      printf 'Run: update-agent-tools\n'
    fi
  fi
}

print_check_failure() {
  local last_successful_check="$1"
  local retry_iso="$2"

  printf 'update-agent-tools: agent-tool update check failed; last successful check: %s; next retry: %s\n' \
    "${last_successful_check:-never}" \
    "$retry_iso" >&2
}

fresh_check_result=""
fresh_check_failure_component=""
run_fresh_check() {
  local output_file
  local error_file
  local last_successful_check
  local cached_result

  output_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/check.stdout.XXXXXX")"
  error_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/check.stderr.XXXXXX")"
  if (check_toolchain) >"$output_file" 2>"$error_file"; then
    fresh_check_result="$(<"$output_file")"
    rm -f "$output_file" "$error_file"
    write_check_state \
      "$now_iso" \
      "$now_iso" \
      "$fresh_check_result" \
      "success"
    return 0
  fi

  fresh_check_failure_component="$(sed -n \
    's/^update-agent-tools-check-component: //p' \
    "$error_file" | tail -n 1)"
  rm -f "$output_file" "$error_file"
  last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  cached_result="$(state_value cached_version_result)"
  write_check_state \
    "$now_iso" \
    "$last_successful_check" \
    "$cached_result" \
    "failed"
  return 1
}

run_check() {
  local last_successful_check
  local retry_iso

  if run_fresh_check; then
    print_cached_result "$fresh_check_result"
    return 0
  fi

  last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  retry_iso="$(date -u -d "@$((now_epoch + 3600))" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  print_check_failure "$last_successful_check" "$retry_iso"
  return 1
}

run_status_check() {
  run_fresh_check || return 1
  if [[ -n "$fresh_check_result" \
    || -n "$(state_value activation_failure)" ]]; then
    return "$CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
  fi
  return 0
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check-status" ]]; then
  [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || fail "--check-status does not accept arguments"
  if run_status_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit $?
  fi
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then
  [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || fail "--check does not accept arguments"
  if run_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check-if-due" \
  || "${1:-}" == "--freshness-check-if-due" ]]; then
  local_last_attempt="$(state_value last_attempt)"
  local_last_successful_check="$(state_value last_successful_check)"
  local_cached_result="$(state_value cached_version_result)"
  local_check_status="$(state_value check_status)"

  if [[ -n "$local_last_attempt" ]]; then
    if [[ "$local_check_status" == "failed" ]]; then
      next_check_epoch="$(date -u -d "$local_last_attempt + 1 hour" +%s)"
    else
      next_check_epoch="$(date -u -d "$local_last_successful_check + 24 hours" +%s)"
    fi

    if (( now_epoch < next_check_epoch )); then
      if [[ "$local_check_status" == "failed" ]]; then
        next_check_iso="$(date -u -d "@$next_check_epoch" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
        print_check_failure "$local_last_successful_check" "$next_check_iso"
      else
        print_cached_result "$local_cached_result"
      fi
      exit 0
    fi
  fi

  if run_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    exit 1
  fi
fi

assume_yes=false
update_if_needed=false
if [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "--yes" ]]; then
  assume_yes=true
elif [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "--update-if-needed" ]]; then
  update_if_needed=true
elif [[ $# -eq 2 && "$1" == "--update-if-needed" && "$2" == "--yes" ]]; then
  update_if_needed=true
  assume_yes=true
elif [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
  fail "unknown argument: $1"
fi

if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
  if run_status_check; then
    exit 0
  else
    status=$?
    if [[ "$status" -ne "$CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE" ]]; then
      fail "discovery phase failed: ${fresh_check_failure_component:-agent-tool version discovery}; correct the problem, then rerun workstation-update"
    fi
  fi
fi

command -v aoe >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || fail "installation failed: AoE command missing from PATH"
captured_workers="$(read_acp_workers)" \
  || fail "unable to inspect running ACP sessions"
captured_workers="$(jq -c '
  [
    .[]
    | select(.alive == true)
    | {session_id, pid}
  ]
  | unique_by([.session_id, .pid])
' <<<"$captured_workers")" \
  || fail "unable to inspect running ACP sessions"
captured_worker_count="$(jq -r 'length' <<<"$captured_workers")"
if [[ "$captured_worker_count" -eq 1 ]]; then
  captured_worker_noun="session"
else
  captured_worker_noun="sessions"
fi
if (( captured_worker_count > 0 )) && [[ "$assume_yes" == false ]]; then
  if [[ ! -t 0 ]]; then
    if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
      fail "$captured_worker_count running ACP $captured_worker_noun would be disrupted; rerun workstation-update --yes to authorize replacement"
    fi
    fail "$captured_worker_count running ACP $captured_worker_noun would be disrupted; rerun with --yes to authorize replacement"
  fi
  printf 'update-agent-tools: %s running ACP %s would be disrupted. Continue? [y/N] ' \
    "$captured_worker_count" "$captured_worker_noun" >&2
  if ! IFS= read -r disruption_confirmation \
    || [[ ! "$disruption_confirmation" =~ ^[Yy]([Ee][Ss])?$ ]]; then
    fail "update cancelled"
  fi
fi

if [[ "$update_if_needed" == true ]]; then
  write_activation_state "" "maintenance" "agent-tool update"
fi

# Bun first: it is the runtime the npm harnesses execute under, so installing it
# ahead of them is what keeps a harness from landing on a Bun too old to run it.
#
# The guard runs here rather than only in discovery because --yes and the bare
# invocation never reach check_toolchain before mutating: the Home Manager
# bootstrap handoff uses --yes, so a floor checked only at discovery would leave
# exactly that path replacing the harnesses first and refusing afterwards.
bun_release="$(resolve_bun_release)" \
  || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime (release metadata)"
bun_target="$(jq -er '.version' <<<"$bun_release")" \
  || fail "installation failed: Bun runtime (release metadata)"
load_managed_npm_metadata \
  || fail "update refused before any change: $managed_npm_metadata_failure (engine metadata unavailable)"
check_runtime_engines "$bun_target" \
  || fail "update refused before any change: $runtime_engine_failure"

if [[ "$(bun_installed_version)" == "$bun_target" ]]; then
  printf 'Bun runtime %s is current\n' "$bun_target"
else
  install_bun_runtime "$bun_release"
fi

if ! aoe update --yes; then
  fail "installation failed: AoE"
fi

for binary in codex claude pi opencode omp; do
  binary_path="$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/$binary"
  if [[ -e "$binary_path" || -L "$binary_path" ]]; then
    rm -f "$binary_path"
  fi
done

for entry in "${MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
  component="${entry%%|*}"
  package="${entry#*|}"
  install_npm_component "$component" "$package@latest"
done

hash -r 2>/dev/null || true

for binary in \
  aoe bun codex claude pi opencode omp codex-acp claude-agent-acp pi-acp; do
  expected_path="$EXPECTED_PREFIX/bin/$binary"
  actual_path="$(command -v "$binary" || true)"
  test "$actual_path" = "$expected_path" \
    || fail "pre-activation verification failed: $binary command must resolve to $expected_path, got ${actual_path:-missing}"
done

for harness in opencode omp pi; do
  "$harness" --version >/dev/null \
    || fail "pre-activation verification failed: $harness --version"
done

verification_output_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/verification.stdout.XXXXXX")"
verification_error_file="$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/verification.stderr.XXXXXX")"
if ! check_toolchain >"$verification_output_file" 2>"$verification_error_file"; then
  verification_component="$(sed -n \
    's/^update-agent-tools-check-component: //p' \
    "$verification_error_file" | tail -n 1)"
  rm -f "$verification_output_file" "$verification_error_file"
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: ${verification_component:-toolchain verification}"
fi
verification_output="$(<"$verification_output_file")"
rm -f "$verification_output_file" "$verification_error_file"
if [[ -n "$verification_output" ]]; then
  failed_component="${verification_output%%:*}"
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: $failed_component version"
fi

if ! aoe acp doctor; then
  fail "pre-activation verification failed: AoE ACP diagnostics"
fi

if ! systemctl --user restart aoe-serve.service; then
  activation_fail "activation" "AoE service restart"
fi

if (( captured_worker_count > 0 )); then
  wait_for_aoe_service \
    || activation_fail "post-activation verification" "AoE service"

  mapfile -t captured_worker_sessions < <(jq -r '
    unique_by(.session_id)
    | .[].session_id
  ' <<<"$captured_workers")
  for worker_session_id in "${captured_worker_sessions[@]}"; do
    current_workers="$(read_acp_workers)" \
      || activation_fail \
        "post-activation verification" \
        "ACP session replacement"
    if jq -e \
      --arg session_id "$worker_session_id" \
      --argjson captured "$captured_workers" '
        ($captured
          | map(select(.session_id == $session_id))
          | first
        ) as $before
        | any(
            .[];
            .session_id == $session_id
            and .pid != $before.pid
          )
      ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    if ! jq -e \
      --arg session_id "$worker_session_id" '
        any(.[]; .session_id == $session_id)
      ' <<<"$current_workers" >/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    if ! aoe acp restart "$worker_session_id"; then
      activation_fail "activation" "ACP worker restart"
    fi
  done

check_runtime_engines() {
  local bun_target="$1"

  local component
  local package
  local engines
  local runtime
  local range
  local floor
  local version

  local runtime_component

    package="${entry#*|}"

    # engines — engine-strict defaults to false, so a floor violation is only a
    # warning there — which means skipping a package whose metadata failed to
    # load installs a harness that may not start, and the run then dies at the
    # post-install `$harness --version` with the harnesses already replaced.

    # refuses before this check. A rerun costs a minute; the alternative costs
    # the toolchain.
    engines="${managed_npm_engines[$package]}"

    # steady state, not a transient failure, so refusing would block updates
    # until an upstream author fixed it. Nothing to check means nothing to fail.
    [[ -n "$engines" ]] || continue

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
readonly REPO_ROOT
readonly COMMAND="$REPO_ROOT/dot_local/bin/executable_update-agent-tools"
readonly CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE=10
REAL_BASH="$(command -v bash)"
REAL_DATE="$(command -v date)"
readonly REAL_BASH REAL_DATE

fail() {
  printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Engine declarations the npm registry serves by default: one Bun floor the
# installed release clears, one Node floor the profile clears.
DEFAULT_OMP_ENGINES='{"bun":">=1.0.0"}'
DEFAULT_PI_ENGINES='{"node":">=20.0.0"}'
readonly DEFAULT_OMP_ENGINES DEFAULT_PI_ENGINES

resolved_command_path() {
  local command_name
  local command_path
  local directory
  local separator=
  declare -A seen=()

  for command_name in "$@"; do
    command_path="$(command -v "$command_name")" \
      || fail "required test dependency not found: $command_name"
    directory="${command_path%/*}"
    [[ -z "${seen[$directory]:-}" ]] || continue
    printf '%s%s' "$separator" "$directory"
    separator=:
    seen["$directory"]=1
  done
}

COMMAND_PATH="$(resolved_command_path \
  bash chmod cut find flock grep head install jq ln mkdir mktemp mv rm sed \
  sha256sum sort tail unzip)"
readonly COMMAND_PATH

make_stubs() {
  local stub_dir="$1"
  local home

  mkdir -p "$stub_dir"
  home="$(dirname "$stub_dir")"
  mkdir -p "$home/.local/bin"

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$home/.local/bin/aoe"
  cat >>"$home/.local/bin/aoe" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "$*" == "--version" ]]; then
  if [[ -e "$HOME/aoe-updated" ]]; then
    printf 'aoe %s\n' "$AOE_LATEST"
  else
    printf 'aoe %s\n' "$AOE_CURRENT"
  fi
  exit 0
fi

printf 'aoe %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"

if [[ "$*" == "update --yes" ]]; then
  if [[ "${AOE_UPDATE_FAIL:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  : >"$HOME/aoe-updated"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$*" == "acp doctor" ]]; then
  doctor_count=0
  if [[ -f "$HOME/doctor-count" ]]; then
    doctor_count="$(<"$HOME/doctor-count")"
  fi
  doctor_count=$((doctor_count + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$doctor_count" >"$HOME/doctor-count"
  if [[ "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_CALL:-0}" == "$doctor_count" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_AFTER:-0}" -gt 0 \
    && "$doctor_count" -ge "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_AFTER}" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$*" == "ps --acp --dead --json" ]]; then
  ps_count=0

  local home="$1"
  local root="$home/bun-archive"

  mkdir -p "$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline"
  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun"

exit 0

  chmod +x "$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun"
  ( cd "$root" && zip --quiet --recurse-paths bun.zip bun-linux-x64-baseline )
  printf 'flags : fpu sse2 sse4_2 bmi1\n' >"$home/cpuinfo-baseline"
  printf 'flags : fpu sse2 sse4_2 bmi1 avx2\n' >"$home/cpuinfo-avx2"

test_machine_status_reports_current_by_exit_status_without_output() {
  local state_file
  local test_dir
  test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' RETURN
  make_stubs "$test_dir/stubs"
  state_file="$test_dir/state/update-agent-tools/state.json"

  run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout" "$test_dir/stderr" --check-status \
    || fail "current machine status exited nonzero: $(<"$test_dir/stderr")"

  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stdout" ]] \
    || fail "current machine status wrote stdout"
  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stderr" ]] \
    || fail "current machine status wrote stderr"
  jq -e '
    .last_attempt == "2026-07-14T00:00:00Z"
    and .last_successful_check == "2026-07-14T00:00:00Z"
    and .cached_version_result == ""
    and .check_status == "success"
  ' "$state_file" >/dev/null \
    || fail "current machine status did not record fresh success"
}

test_machine_status_reports_outdated_by_exit_status_without_output() {
  local state_file
  local status
  local test_dir
  test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' RETURN
  make_stubs "$test_dir/stubs"
  state_file="$test_dir/state/update-agent-tools/state.json"

  if AOE_CURRENT="1.2.2" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout" "$test_dir/stderr" --check-status; then
    fail "outdated machine status exited zero"
  else
    status=$?
  fi

  [[ "$status" -eq "$CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE" ]] \
    || fail "outdated machine status exited $status instead of $CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stdout" ]] \
    || fail "outdated machine status wrote stdout"
  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stderr" ]] \
    || fail "outdated machine status wrote stderr"
  jq -e '
    .last_attempt == "2026-07-14T00:00:00Z"
    and .last_successful_check == "2026-07-14T00:00:00Z"
    and .cached_version_result == "AoE: 1.2.2 -> 1.2.3"
    and .check_status == "success"
  ' "$state_file" >/dev/null \
    || fail "outdated machine status did not record fresh success"
  if grep -Eq '^(aoe update|aoe ps --acp|aoe acp restart|npm install|systemctl )' \
    "$test_dir/command-log"; then
    fail "outdated machine status mutated or inspected ACP workers"
  fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
readonly REPO_ROOT
readonly COMMAND="$REPO_ROOT/dot_local/bin/executable_update-agent-tools"
readonly CHECK_STATUS_UPDATES_AVAILABLE=10
REAL_BASH="$(command -v bash)"
REAL_DATE="$(command -v date)"
readonly REAL_BASH REAL_DATE

fail() {
  printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Engine declarations the npm registry serves by default: one Bun floor the
# installed release clears, one Node floor the profile clears.
DEFAULT_OMP_ENGINES='{"bun":">=1.0.0"}'
DEFAULT_PI_ENGINES='{"node":">=20.0.0"}'
readonly DEFAULT_OMP_ENGINES DEFAULT_PI_ENGINES

resolved_command_path() {
  local command_name
  local command_path
  local directory
  local separator=
  declare -A seen=()

  for command_name in "$@"; do
    command_path="$(command -v "$command_name")" \
      || fail "required test dependency not found: $command_name"
    directory="${command_path%/*}"
    [[ -z "${seen[$directory]:-}" ]] || continue
    printf '%s%s' "$separator" "$directory"
    separator=:
    seen["$directory"]=1
  done
}

COMMAND_PATH="$(resolved_command_path \
  bash chmod cut find flock grep head install jq ln mkdir mktemp mv rm sed \
  sha256sum sort tail unzip)"
readonly COMMAND_PATH

make_stubs() {
  local stub_dir="$1"
  local home

  mkdir -p "$stub_dir"
  home="$(dirname "$stub_dir")"
  mkdir -p "$home/.local/bin"

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$home/.local/bin/aoe"
  cat >>"$home/.local/bin/aoe" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "$*" == "--version" ]]; then
  if [[ -e "$HOME/aoe-updated" ]]; then
    printf 'aoe %s\n' "$AOE_LATEST"

printf 'aoe %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"

if [[ "$*" == "update --yes" ]]; then

    exit 1
  fi
  : >"$HOME/aoe-updated"

fi

  doctor_count=0
  if [[ -f "$HOME/doctor-count" ]]; then
    doctor_count="$(<"$HOME/doctor-count")"
  fi
  doctor_count=$((doctor_count + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$doctor_count" >"$HOME/doctor-count"
  if [[ "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_CALL:-0}" == "$doctor_count" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_AFTER:-0}" -gt 0 \
    && "$doctor_count" -ge "${AOE_DOCTOR_FAIL_AFTER}" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$*" == "ps --acp --dead --json" ]]; then

  if [[ -f "$HOME/acp-ps-count" ]]; then

  fi
  ps_count=$((ps_count + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$ps_count" >"$HOME/acp-ps-count"
  jq -c --argjson index "$((ps_count - 1))" '
    if length == 0 then []
    elif $index < length then .[$index]
    else .[-1]
    end
  ' <<<"$ACP_PS_SEQUENCE_JSON"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$1" == "acp" && "$2" == "restart" && $# -eq 3 ]]; then
  [[ "${ACP_RESTART_FAIL:-0}" != "1" ]]
  exit
fi

printf 'unexpected aoe invocation: %s\n' "$*" >&2
exit 64
STUB

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$stub_dir/curl"
  cat >>"$stub_dir/curl" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "$*" == "-fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/njbrake/agent-of-empires/releases/latest" ]]; then

  if [[ -n "${CURL_GATE:-}" ]] \

    exit 0

  esac

  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$1" == "view" && "$3" == "version" ]]; then
  printf 'npm %s\n' "$*" >>"$QUERY_LOG"
  case "$2" in
    '@openai/codex@latest') printf '%s\n' "$CODEX_LATEST" ;;
    '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest') printf '%s\n' "$CLAUDE_LATEST" ;;
    '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest') printf '%s\n' "$PI_LATEST" ;;

    '@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@latest') printf '%s\n' "$CLAUDE_ACP_LATEST" ;;
    'pi-acp@latest') printf '%s\n' "$PI_ACP_LATEST" ;;
    *) printf 'unexpected npm package: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "$1" == "install" && "$2" == "--global" ]]; then
  package="$3"
  if [[ "${NPM_REQUIRE_CLEARED_SHIMS:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    for stale_binary in codex claude pi opencode omp; do
      stale_path="$HOME/.local/bin/$stale_binary"
      if [[ -e "$stale_path" || -L "$stale_path" ]] \
        && grep -Fx 'stale-shim' "$stale_path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'stale shim blocked npm install: %s\n' "$stale_binary" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
    done
  fi
  if [[ "${NPM_INSTALL_FAIL_PACKAGE:-}" == "$package" ]]; then
    exit 1
  fi
  case "$package" in
    '@openai/codex@latest') binary=codex ;;
    '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest') binary=claude ;;
    '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest') binary=pi ;;
    'opencode-ai@latest') binary=opencode ;;
    '@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@latest') binary=omp ;;
    '@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@latest') binary=codex-acp ;;
    '@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@latest') binary=claude-agent-acp ;;
    'pi-acp@latest') binary=pi-acp ;;
    *) printf 'unexpected npm install package: %s\n' "$package" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$binary" != "${NPM_OMIT_BINARY:-}" ]]; then
    printf '#!%s\nprintf "%s %%s\\n" "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"\nexit 0\n' \
      "$TEST_REAL_BASH" "$binary" \
      >"$HOME/.local/bin/$binary"
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/$binary"
  fi
  if [[ "$package" == "@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@latest" ]]; then
    : >"$HOME/npm-installed"
  fi
  exit 0
fi

printf 'unexpected npm invocation: %s\n' "$*" >&2
exit 64
STUB

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$stub_dir/systemctl"
  cat >>"$stub_dir/systemctl" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail

printf 'systemctl %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"
if [[ "$*" == "--user restart aoe-serve.service" ]]; then
  [[ "${SYSTEMCTL_RESTART_FAIL:-0}" != "1" ]]
  exit
fi
if [[ "$*" == "--user is-active --quiet aoe-serve.service" ]]; then
  [[ "${SYSTEMCTL_INACTIVE:-0}" != "1" ]]
  exit
fi
exit 64
STUB

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$stub_dir/sleep"
  cat >>"$stub_dir/sleep" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail
printf 'sleep %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"
STUB

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$stub_dir/date"
  cat >>"$stub_dir/date" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail
printf 'date %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"
exec "$TEST_REAL_DATE" "$@"
STUB

  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$stub_dir/node"
  cat >>"$stub_dir/node" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail
printf 'v%s\n' "$NODE_VERSION"
STUB

  make_bun_archive "$home"
  # An ordinary workstation already has a Bun; tests that need it absent remove
  # it, the way the transition off the Nix-provided one leaves the host.
  cp "$home/bun-archive/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun" "$home/.local/bin/bun"
  chmod +x "$home/.local/bin/bun"
  ln -sfn bun "$home/.local/bin/bunx"

  chmod +x "$home/.local/bin/aoe" "$stub_dir/curl" "$stub_dir/npm" \
    "$stub_dir/systemctl" "$stub_dir/sleep" "$stub_dir/date" "$stub_dir/node"
}

# The updater unpacks whatever the release serves, so the fixture has to be a
# real archive laid out the way Bun ships one: <archive-root>/bun.
make_bun_archive() {
  local home="$1"
  local root="$home/bun-archive"

  mkdir -p "$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline"
  printf '#!%s\n' "$REAL_BASH" >"$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun"
  cat >>"$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun" <<'STUB'
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "$*" == "--version" ]]; then
  if [[ -s "$HOME/bun-installed" ]]; then
    cat "$HOME/bun-installed"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$BUN_CURRENT"
  fi
  exit 0
fi

printf 'bun %s\n' "$*" >>"$COMMAND_LOG"
exit 0
STUB
  chmod +x "$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline/bun"
  ( cd "$root" && zip --quiet --recurse-paths bun.zip bun-linux-x64-baseline )
  printf 'flags : fpu sse2 sse4_2 bmi1\n' >"$home/cpuinfo-baseline"
  printf 'flags : fpu sse2 sse4_2 bmi1 avx2\n' >"$home/cpuinfo-avx2"
}


execute_tool() {
  local stdout_file="$1"
  local stderr_file="$2"
  local command_line
  shift 2

  if [[ "${TEST_RUN_IN_TTY:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf -v command_line '%q ' bash "$COMMAND" "$@"
    printf '%s' "${TEST_TTY_INPUT:-}" \
      | script -qefc "$command_line" /dev/null \
        >"$stdout_file" 2>"$stderr_file"
  else
    bash "$COMMAND" "$@" </dev/null >"$stdout_file" 2>"$stderr_file"
  fi
}

  local home="$1"

  mkdir -p "$root/bun-linux-x64-baseline"

  ( cd "$root" && zip --quiet --recurse-paths bun.zip bun-linux-x64-baseline )

test_machine_status_reports_current_by_exit_status_without_output() {

    || fail "current machine status exited nonzero: $(<"$test_dir/stderr")"

  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stderr" ]] \
    || fail "current machine status wrote stderr"
  jq -e '
    .last_attempt == "2026-07-14T00:00:00Z"

  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stderr" ]] \

  jq -e '

test_concurrent_due_checks_are_serialized() {
  local first_pid
  local second_pid
  local state_dir
  local test_dir
  local wait_count=0
  test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' RETURN
  make_stubs "$test_dir/stubs"
  state_dir="$test_dir/state/update-agent-tools"

  CURL_GATE="$test_dir/curl-gate" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-1" "$test_dir/stderr-1" --check-if-due &
  first_pid=$!
  while [[ ! -e "$test_dir/curl-gate.ready" && $wait_count -lt 500 ]]; do
    sleep 0.01
    wait_count=$((wait_count + 1))
  done
  [[ -e "$test_dir/curl-gate.ready" ]] \
    || fail "first concurrent check did not reach the release query"

  run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-2" "$test_dir/stderr-2" --check-if-due &
  second_pid=$!
  sleep 0.05
  : >"$test_dir/curl-gate.release"
  wait "$first_pid" || fail "first concurrent check exited nonzero"
  wait "$second_pid" || fail "second concurrent check exited nonzero"

  [[ "$(wc -l <"$test_dir/query-log")" -eq 10 ]] \
    || fail "concurrent due checks performed duplicate release queries"
  jq -e '.check_status == "success"' "$state_dir/state.json" >/dev/null \
    || fail "concurrent checks left invalid state"
  if compgen -G "$state_dir/state.json.tmp.*" >/dev/null; then
    fail "atomic state write left a temporary file"
  fi
}

  local state_file
  local test_dir
  test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' RETURN
  make_stubs "$test_dir/stubs"
  state_file="$test_dir/state/update-agent-tools/state.json"

  AOE_CURRENT="1.2.2" \
    UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW="2026-07-08T04:00:00Z" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-1" "$test_dir/stderr-1" --check-if-due \
    || fail "malformed-AoE cache seed exited nonzero: $(<"$test_dir/stderr-1")"

  expected_failure='update-agent-tools: agent-tool update check failed; last successful check: 2026-07-08T04:00:00Z; next retry: 2026-07-09T05:00:00Z'
  if AOE_LATEST="not-a-version" \
    UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW="2026-07-09T04:00:00Z" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-2" "$test_dir/stderr-2" --check-if-due; then
    fail "malformed AoE release was committed as a successful check"
  fi
  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stdout-2" ]] \
    || fail "malformed AoE release presented cached output as current"
  diff -u <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_failure") "$test_dir/stderr-2" \
    || fail "malformed AoE release failure output did not match"
  jq -e '
    .last_attempt == "2026-07-09T04:00:00Z"
    and .last_successful_check == "2026-07-08T04:00:00Z"
    and .cached_version_result == "AoE: 1.2.2 -> 1.2.3"
    and .check_status == "failed"
  ' "$state_file" >/dev/null \
    || fail "malformed AoE release replaced the last known-good state"

  UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW="2026-07-09T04:59:59Z" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-3" "$test_dir/stderr-3" --check-if-due \
    || fail "malformed-AoE pre-retry check exited nonzero"
  diff -u <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_failure") "$test_dir/stderr-3" \
    || fail "malformed-AoE pre-retry output did not match"
  [[ "$(jq -r '.last_attempt' "$state_file")" == "2026-07-09T04:00:00Z" ]] \
    || fail "malformed-AoE pre-retry check performed an early attempt"

  UPDATE_AGENT_TOOLS_NOW="2026-07-09T05:00:00Z" \
    run_tool "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout-4" "$test_dir/stderr-4" --check-if-due \
    || fail "malformed-AoE one-hour retry exited nonzero: $(<"$test_dir/stderr-4")"
  jq -e '
    .last_attempt == "2026-07-09T05:00:00Z"
    and .last_successful_check == "2026-07-09T05:00:00Z"
    and .check_status == "success"
  ' "$state_file" >/dev/null \
    || fail "malformed AoE release did not retry at one hour"
}

test_current_toolchain_is_silent() {
  local test_dir
  test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' RETURN
  make_stubs "$test_dir/stubs"
  mkdir -p "$test_dir/.local/bin"
  for binary in codex claude pi; do
    printf 'sentinel-%s\n' "$binary" >"$test_dir/.local/bin/$binary"
  done

  if ! run_check "$test_dir" "$test_dir/stdout" "$test_dir/stderr"; then
    fail "current toolchain check exited nonzero: $(<"$test_dir/stderr")"
  fi

  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stdout" ]] \
    || fail "current toolchain check wrote stdout: $(<"$test_dir/stdout")"
  [[ ! -s "$test_dir/stderr" ]] \
    || fail "current toolchain check wrote stderr: $(<"$test_dir/stderr")"
  for binary in codex claude pi; do
    [[ "$(<"$test_dir/.local/bin/$binary")" == "sentinel-$binary" ]] \
      || fail "current toolchain check changed the installed $binary binary"
  done
}
